name: Festival Stone of Foredawn
title: Festival Stone of Foredawn
summary: Two rows of twelve Empyrean pillars cross the river east of Shoushi, the unbroken ones crowned with eternal flames; 128 m east of the last pillar the Festival Stone of Foredawn stands between two Master's Sentinel candles with its Anniversary glow, and behind it a meeting hall with pillars and the Refreshing Fountain.

landmarks.name: Flaming pillar avenue
landmarks.note: Two rows (y 16350 / 16360) of Empyrean pillars from x 42497 to 42630 across the river, 12 Flames spawns on top (z 10.7-14.6).

landmarks.name: Festival Stone of Foredawn
landmarks.note: With two Master's Sentinel candles and the Anniversary Effect glow (z 21).

site.name: Festival Stone of Foredawn
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer foredawn-festival-stone (bank 9 m west of the stone); the pillar avenue is 130-260 m west, inside the 300 m site radius.

shots.standingOrder: Fly due west at 8 m/s, 9 m above the river, down the centre of the double row of flaming Empyrean pillars toward the setting sun; stay 3.8 m from every flame.
shots.notes: Flagship flame shot: flies down the centre of the two rows of Empyrean pillars across the river, eternal flames on top of the pillars passing 4 m either side at eye level, toward the low setting sun (0.75) for full backlight on flames and water.
